ERR_PROV_FULL.message: No room for another connection: every slot is taken

ERR_PROV_IN_USE.message: Provider {provider} is taken: something already reads from it
ERR_PROV_IN_USE.hint: Stop what reads from it first.

ERR_PROV_SYSTEM.message: Provider {provider} belongs to the board and cannot be removed

ERR_PROV_TOO_LONG.message: {len} bytes are too long for Provider {provider} (at most {max})

ERR_PROV_BUSY.message: Provider {provider} is busy: its send queue is full
ERR_PROV_BUSY.hint: Send less often, or wait for the connection to catch up.

ERR_PROV_NO_RX.message: Provider {provider} hands nothing on: a driver reads from it directly
ERR_PROV_NO_RX.hint: Make the port in a raw mode to bind a stream or a session to it.
